interface.label: Sandbox
interface.description: Execution environments with a filesystem and a shell: create/exec/read/write/list against any connected sandbox host. Each backend is a handwritten UTDK provider module built on @utdk/sandbox. Secrets live in the provider credential (API token, or a local host's client token); the API root, default image and region ride the binding options. Workspace-facing mounting, sync and commit live in the `sandboxes` core service — see docs/sandboxes.md.
